comment: The pattern length is fixed at sixteen steps (src/KIMO.cpp:284) and the rotation at zero, so FILL is the only control over the pattern. The FM sweep is twenty octaves at the top of the knob (src/KIMO.cpp:511) but the oscillator frequency is then held below 45 per cent of the sample rate (src/KIMO.cpp:218). The saturator is tanh(sine * (1 + punch*2)) normalised by tanh of the same figure (src/KIMO.cpp:225-227). Several CV jacks add a tenth of the knob's travel per volt rather than one of the four range shapes, so range is left off those. The panel prints CLK, FILL, ACCENT, DELAY, TUNE, FM, PUNCH, DECAY, SHAPE and, over the lower jacks, FILL, TUNE, FM, PUNCH and DECAY again; the four output jacks carry no lettering. Lettering is drawn in code at src/KIMO.cpp:541-618.
